nodeId.description: The id of the {@link App.Node node} that this thread is running on.

threadPoolName.description: The name of the {@link App.Node.ThreadPool thread pool} that this thread is running in.

engineName.description: The name of the {@link Engine engine} that this thread is running in.

isReady.description: Whether the thread is ready to take tasks.

uptime.description: {@link Duration} since the thread was started.

started.description: The {@link DateTime} when the thread was started.

currentAction.description: The {@link Action} that is currently running on this thread, null if no action is running.

title: This c3 type is used to represent the summary of a thread. {@link App.Node.Thread#summary}
name: App.Node.Thread.Info
